name: kmm-pr-reviewer
description: Regression-detection counterpart to kmm-migration. Reviews KMM-migration PRs against the prod Android app with the same paranoia level the migration enforces. Read-only orchestrator: classifies every changed file (migrated / nonmigrated / ios_port / baseline / build_config), dispatches a per-file Sonnet reviewer with a classification-specific checklist (file is not complete until every box ticks), runs a single-pass triager subagent that re-verifies every finding against the actual diff to drop false positives, then presents a cherry-pick markdown checklist to the user. On approval, posts a single GitHub review with inline line-level comments and a summary body via gh CLI. Mirrors kmm-migration's orchestration: Opus drives, Sonnet reviews, Haiku posts. 10 review laws enforce evidence-before-claims, no-trust-in-producer-reports, and read-only operation outside the final posting subagent.
